slug:drop.name: DROP
slug:drop.description: A crowdsourced, adversarially-created reading comprehension benchmark of ~96k questions requiring discrete reasoning (addition, counting, sorting) over paragraphs.

reference.title: DROP: A Reading Comprehension Benchmark Requiring Discrete Reasoning Over Paragraphs

slug:mgsm.name: MGSM (Multilingual Grade School Math)
slug:mgsm.description: The same 250 GSM8K grade-school math problems professionally translated into 10 languages (plus English) for evaluating multilingual chain-of-thought reasoning.
slug:mgsm.size: 250 test examples per language across 11 languages (2,750 total)

reference.title: Language Models are Multilingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoners

slug:multipl-e.name: MultiPL-E
slug:multipl-e.description: A dataset for evaluating code generation LLMs that translates the OpenAI HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks into 22 programming languages using automated compiler-based translation.
slug:multipl-e.size: Varies by language/config (e.g. humaneval-adb: 157 test examples); 22 languages total across HumanEval and MBPP source sets

reference.title: MultiPL-E: A Scalable and Extensible Approach to Benchmarking Neural Code Generation

slug:quac.name: QuAC (Question Answering in Context)
slug:quac.description: A dataset for question answering in context containing information-seeking dialogs between a student and teacher over hidden Wikipedia text, with ~100K questions total across 14K dialogs.

slug:squad.name: SQuAD (Stanford Question Answering Dataset)
slug:squad.description: A reading comprehension dataset of questions posed by crowdworkers on Wikipedia articles, where the answer is a span of text from the corresponding passage.

reference.title: SQuAD: 100,000+ Questions for Machine Comprehension of Text

slug:triviaqa-wiki.name: TriviaQA (Wikipedia subset)
slug:triviaqa-wiki.description: A reading comprehension dataset of trivia question-answer pairs with distantly supervised evidence documents; the 'wikipedia' config restricts evidence to Wikipedia pages.

reference.title: TriviaQA: A Large Scale Distantly Supervised Challenge Dataset for Reading Comprehension
